name: Plate I: The Squaring of the Circle
description: Make of man and woman a circle, then a square, then a triangle, then a circle, and you will have the Stone (Maier, Atalanta Fugiens, Emblem XXI). Struck in Lapis Lazuli: ground lapis, the stone of the night sky and of Egyptian heaven. “OBSCVRVM PER OBSCVRIVS”: The obscure by the more obscure.
